kind: Root-reviewable exact gap and integration proposal; no complete product patch claimed
status: Current protocol cannot express or persist an OwnCondition upload binding. Root corrective selection required.

findings.fact: target_access checks only type RBAC and target existence. FullProject must be verified in the same source-read transaction for project/contract list and normal access.
readable, center:1601, history:1268 and active-link summaries bypass real project scope; a single I evidence reader fix cannot protect these original routes.

Live upload/link/list DTOs have no relatedField, completionRecordId, conditionId or businessContext. Six target types and five relation types are closed enums. UploadSession has no JSON business context; description is free user text. The validator strips unknown fields.

Read helpers use independent Database.with_connection calls; flush_guarded:1720 opens its own transaction at1749. A separate Scope precheck cannot establish same-CommonSession authority for later reads/writes.

options.name: Zero new HTTP/DDL with explicit typed existing-route context and authoritative binding producer
options.change: Root corrective adds optional typed project/completion/condition context to the existing upload/read protocol, shared/OpenAPI/client/validator. A required server-produced self-hashed versioned scope-binding audit metadata fact may use existing audit_log JSON, written with session insert and reloaded in each phase under actual Condition scope.
options.limit: This audit binding is not already implemented or authorized as an authority source. Root must define unique binding, immutability, cardinality, actor/session/project/condition identity, request hash, producer and consumption semantics before it is usable. Do not treat arbitrary audit text as proof.

options.name: Dedicated persistent binding
options.change: Add exact typed scope-context column or binding table with project/completion/condition/session FKs and immutable producer facts; explicit protocol context on existing routes. More direct storage semantics, outside zero-DDL request.
